facts.fact: Phil 搬进前任 Miss Bredon 的房间，桌子既被多年使用磨出痕迹，还看得出像好几处弹孔
教师宿舍安排在校区北翼，那一翼石墙多于木墙
facts.anchor: The teachers were housed in the northern wing of the building

facts.fact: Miss Bredon 曾给六年级部分学生排过自由形式的拉丁文会话课，不属于任何考试范围
Phil 关上衣柜门时震落窗框里折着的一张纸
facts.anchor: A folded piece of paper clattered to the floor

facts.fact: 纸上第一行是拉丁文，Phil 只能把后半句译成「is weak / Is deceptive / Is unreliable」
facts.anchor: Si fuerit in triangulo, mentitur in cunctis

facts.fact: Phil 认出纸上的笔迹属于 Anne Bredon，因为她在课程表上见过这手字
facts.anchor: The handwriting was that of Anne Bredon

facts.fact: 纸背第二段用缩写 M 与 HJ 说话，写她从没这么久没见到 M，HJ 也因此才肯收她
facts.anchor: Have never had to go so long without M

facts.fact: Phil 推测信里的缩写 HJ 就是校长 Head 本人
facts.anchor: the Head (surely the true identity of HJ)

facts.fact: Mr Smithson 用反问提醒 Phil：从 Grayne’s 离开的教师从此没人听说过下落
facts.anchor: why you never hear about what happens to teachers who leave Grayne’s

facts.fact: Hamish 讲学校旧事：学生们用实弹打了一场战棋，官方口径是历史重演
facts.anchor: Conducted a wargame with live ammunition

facts.fact: Jane Worth 夜访酒馆并非私事，而是校长派她来把 Phil 带回学校
facts.anchor: She was the one who sent me to collect you

facts.fact: Jane 断言 Hamish 是教育部的探子，因为该部门想找借口关掉 Grayne’s
facts.anchor: He’s obviously a spy from the Department for Education

facts.fact: Phil 故意把苹果酒泼到 Hamish 身上，借机结束这场让自己不安的谈话
facts.anchor: overturned her cider into Hamish’s lap

facts.fact: 进酒馆前 Phil 利用镇上的手机信号给亲友发了短信，准备从校方之外另找答案
facts.anchor: had sent several texts to friends and family
